Do not register with this GP unless you want to be neglected and charged extortionate fees for disabled medical support.

Extremely disappointed with this practice. I’ve been a patient here for over 10+ years and it just seems to get worse. The front desk workers are rude, cold and very insensitive. Communication is poor, follow-ups for mental health and chronic conditions are inconsistent, and appointments are often hard to get. Don’t even expect a timely responses to emails in matters of escalation or crisis.

Recently, I was asked to pay £30 for a simple university support letter — an unfair and unreasonable fee, especially given my long-term medical condition and recent injury. This feels exploitative and shows a worrying lack of empathy for patients with ongoing health needs. I have never felt so ignored and mishandled, especially in the experience of health decline. Not a team you can rely upon - I hope to switch soon and hopefully receive better care and support.

Overall, I cannot recommend this practice. Patients seeking reliable, supportive care should look elsewhere.",null,[0,158]]]],[null,null,null,null,null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/10331144093608690632/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjFyZDFreVRuQlBSRXBNVFZSYU0xTlViSFZrTWxweFUwVkZkMVF5WXhBQhAA"]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21rd1kyTnBPREpMTVRaM1NUbHVkMlpxU0VFd1QyYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0x7d0fcf7460ea9ece!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmkwY2NpODJLMTZ3STlud2ZqSEEwT2c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21rd1kyTnBPREpMTVRaM1NUbHVkMlpxU0VFd1QyYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiszbqkgbCTAxWQHWMBHYa9PSQQoykIECgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiszbqkgbCTAxWQHWMBHYa9PSQQ0pMFCA4oBA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMUpPYVcxa2RsOWZSV2hDYjFSMGJIYzNlV1J6TW1kVGVuUkNPRUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYzBOYVJUSkxXakk0V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21FdFIzcGxkazVrVms1RWVVVjRXalpsY0RWdGFVRRAB",["0x0:0x7d0fcf7460ea9ece",null,1767987055851769,1767987783601384,[null,null,["htt
